kultivator.guide.chapter.23.desc: The townsfolk are real people: they have names, families, temperaments, feelings and a memory of you. Talk to them, help them, share their lives, trade and hold office in the town, and watch the town grow with you.
kultivator.guide.c23.sapa.title: Greet Five Townsfolk
kultivator.guide.c23.sapa.body:
Right-click any townsperson: a vendor, a porter, a granny at the well, a child at play. Every civilian can now be talked to, not only merchants and story characters.
The greeting sheet shows a portrait, name, age, work and their relation to you, then the tablets Talk, News, Ask the Way, Relations, Favour, Give and Services when they have any.
The opening line is assembled by the conversation engine from the real situation: the hour, weather, season, town event, their mood and their impression of you. The same line is not repeated to you within 3 world days.
A working townsperson stops and looks at you; when you finish they return to their schedule. Talk to five different townsfolk.
kultivator.guide.c23.kenal.title: Known by Name
kultivator.guide.c23.kenal.body:
Every townsperson remembers up to 6 players: how often you met, their impression (-100 to 100), your help, debts, the last gift and four strong memories.
They know your name once you choose [Introduce yourself] on the Talk tablet, when your Good Name in that place is 60 or more, or when gossip about you reaches them. Until then they address you by realm: Master Cultivator, Lady Swordswoman, Senior.
A greeting gives +1 impression a day (at most 20 from greetings alone); impressions drift back to 0, one point per 4 days, except those from strong events such as saving their life.
Impressions change the greeting, a merchant's personal price (up to 5 %), the will to share news and the favours they ask.
kultivator.guide.c23.kabar.title: Trace a Rumour
kultivator.guide.c23.kabar.body:
Rumours are born from real events: your deeds, weddings, births, deaths, brawls, rising prices, new shops. Each place holds up to 64 live rumours.
They spread on Townsfolk Day and whenever two townsfolk chat, faster at the well (x3), the tea house (x2) and the market (x1.5). At each hop 15 % get spiced up: two pickpockets become five. Their heat drops by 10 a day.
On the News tablet a townsperson tells 1-3 rumours they know, in their temperament's style. Choose [Ask who said so] to point at the previous teller, then ask that person, until you reach the source.
Truth is never marked: you judge it yourself, and a rumour chain is also evidence in town court cases.
kultivator.guide.c23.tolong.title: Ten Favours
kultivator.guide.c23.tolong.body:
Favours come from real needs: a sick parent, firewood in winter, a lost cat, a child lost outside the walls, a letter for a sweetheart, two feuding neighbours, a loan shark, thugs, a picked pocket, the harvest, materials for a damaged house.
Each townsperson has at most one favour, each place six, and you can accept three a day. The goals are real: deliver 16 logs, find the child at the town's edge, beat the thugs without killing.
A finished favour gives +15 impression and the strong memory HELPED; the reward is NB, home cooking or another kindness fitting your band.
Promise with care: whatever you say [I will ...] is remembered and called in.
kultivator.guide.c23.upacara.title: Weddings and Funerals
kultivator.guide.c23.upacara.body:
A wedding runs 09:00-21:00: the matchmaker knocks, the groom rides with suona players, the veiled bride comes in the red sedan chair, three bows at the groom's house, then the banquet 18:00-21:00. Give a red envelope (at least 2 x (band+1) NB): +10 impression with both families and a Wedding Cake.
A funeral is held the morning after a death, 08:00-11:00: white lanterns at the house, the family in white mourning, the coffin carried to the Grave Hill. Give condolence money: +12 impression.
Births: the father hands out red eggs; at one year the baby picks one of eight objects in the zhuazhou ceremony.
Ceremonies are real events of the townsfolk and visible within 96 blocks. Attend one wedding or one funeral.
kultivator.guide.c23.rumah.title: A House in Town
kultivator.guide.c23.rumah.body:
Houses For Sale: 2-6 per town, 8 in the capital, plus townsfolk houses left empty when a household moved or died out.
Base price: small 300 NB, medium 900, large 2,400, shop house 1,800, courtyard pavilion 6,000, times the place factor (village 0.5 up to capital 2.0) and its prosperity. Rent is 3 % of the price per 7 days. Good Name 10 (rent) or 20 (buy).
Your house is your claim: no repair bills inside, build freely. The House Key takes you to its door (3 s channel, 30 minute cooldown). Property tax 1 % per 7 days.
At most one house per place and 4 in all.
kultivator.guide.c23.toko.title: Your Own Shop
kultivator.guide.c23.toko.body:
Open a shop in a shop house you own or rent a Town Stall in the market (6 x (band+1) NB a week). Place Trade Racks (3 stacks shown, price labels), a Counter and a Shop Sign; at most 12 racks count.
Buyers come every hour while the shop is open, busiest at 9-11 and 17-19, more in the market than in the residential streets. Up to 1.1 x value sells 80 % of the time, up to 1.5 x only 20 %.
Hire an idle townsperson (8-15 NB a week) or a disciple as staff; without a cashier the shop only sells while you are there. Shop reputation rises with fair prices and variety.
This step is done when your shop has sold a hundred goods.
kultivator.guide.c23.investasi.title: Invest in a Business
kultivator.guide.c23.investasi.body:
Eating houses, tea houses, taverns, cloth shops, smithies, apothecaries, inns and other businesses are owned by real townsfolk, with a daily turnover from traffic, mood and the owner's skill.
Invest 50 to 200 x (band+1) NB per business, at most 3 businesses per place and 10 in all. Profit shares are paid weekly by your stake, 3-6 % on average, and can be losses.
Festivals raise profit by 40 %, a small fire wipes out a week, an owner who takes to drink lowers it. Withdraw with 7 days' notice.
In the capital and themed cities the broker is Master Shen Wan; in small towns talk to the owner directly.
kultivator.guide.c23.pasar_hantu.title: The Ghost Market
kultivator.guide.c23.pasar_hantu.body:
In the fifth watch, 01:00-05:00, the Ghost Market opens in one of the town's hidden corners: under a bridge, an empty warehouse, a dead-end alley, by the graves outside the walls, an old pier. It moves every night.
Find the way: the night password from a Tea House token, a beggar child guide (5 NB), townsfolk who love to snoop, or the green lanterns visible from 48 blocks.
Paper-masked sellers offer shadow goods, rare maps and stolen goods; the fence buys stolen goods at 0.6 x value. A Ghost Market Mask gives 10 % off and protects you in a raid (10 % a night).
No faces seen, no names asked: that is the rule.
kultivator.guide.c23.ronda.title: The Night Watch
kultivator.guide.c23.ronda.body:
Two night watchmen walk every town with a hand gong, a wooden clapper and a lantern. Five watches: 19:00, 21:00, 23:00, 01:00 and 03:00, each opened with a patterned beat and a call such as "Dry skies, dry things, mind the fire!".
They knock on doors, see drunks home, report small fires and chase thieves.
Choose [Join the watch] and walk one full watch with them: Good Name +1, 3 NB from the Town Treasury, and three times the chance to catch a thief.
Lao Geng is old; one day his apprentice Xiao Bang inherits his gong.
kultivator.guide.c23.copet.title: Catch a Pickpocket
kultivator.guide.c23.copet.body:
In a market or festival crowd a pickpocket may bump into you: "Your purse feels lighter!". Foundation cultivators and above sometimes sense it first and can [Catch the hand] within 1.5 seconds.
Chase them for 30 seconds through the alleys; one blow brings them to their knees. You get your goods back, Good Name +2, and the onlookers are impressed.
A pickpocket who escapes sells your goods at the Ghost Market that night; you can buy them back.
Nobody dies in the town's street events: brawls are broken up, fires put out, overturned carts lifted.
kultivator.guide.c23.jabatan.title: Town Office
kultivator.guide.c23.jabatan.body:
Five ranks per town: Honorary Scribe (Good Name 40), Market Inspector (55), Assistant Magistrate (70, Foundation), Deputy Mayor (80, Golden Core) and Mayor (90, Nascent Soul). In the capital the highest is Honorary Minister.
The Market Inspector checks the scales, the Assistant Magistrate tries two cases a week with witnesses and evidence, the Deputy Mayor picks the next plot building, the Mayor sets the tax at 5-20 %.
Wages come from the Town Treasury. Taking a bribe gives NB and Infamy; a higher official may audit you.
Staying away 28 days lowers your rank by one. This step is done at the third rank.
kultivator.guide.c23.kantor.title: The Recruitment Office
kultivator.guide.c23.kantor.body:
With a hall of level 2 or more you can rent a Recruitment Office booth in town (village 5, town 10, themed city 15, capital 25 NB per 7 days).
Applicants are rooted children and youths of the town, with name, age, temperament, zhuazhou result and their family's stance. Test their root at the Testing Stone (2 NB), then accept or refuse; at most 3 accepted per office per 7 days.
Proud families let them go freely, doubtful ones ask a blessing gift, refusing ones open the quest "Father's Blessing".
When leaving, the child embraces their parents and walks to the gate with a bundle.
kultivator.guide.c23.pakta.title: A Protection Pact
kultivator.guide.c23.pakta.body:
Your sect can protect a town (hall level 3) or a village (level 2) with Good Name 50, at most 3 places.
Half the places start under the nearest NPC sect: take over through talks with its envoy, a bout with its champion, or when the town elders choose you.
Weekly tribute 30 x (band+1) x town class NB plus surplus goods, renown +5 and Good Name +1 a week.
Your duty is the Call to Defend the Town: come yourself or send two Foundation disciples within one world day. Three failures in a row break the pact.
kultivator.guide.c23.kavling.title: The Growing Town
kultivator.guide.c23.kavling.body:
Towns have fenced plots with a "Town Plot" sign (capital 24, themed city 8-12, town 6, village 2-4). When prosperity is 55 or more and the town is crowded or has idle hands, one plot starts building.
Each building rises in five stages: foundation, frame, walls, roof, fittings. The foreman and his crew place block after block; your own blocks on a plot are never overwritten.
Help by selling or donating wood, stone, roof tiles, glass and cloth on the Plot screen (Good Name +1 per 32 goods).
Done: an opening with a lion dance and firecrackers, a new family moves in or a new business opens.
kultivator.guide.c23.generasi.title: A Generation
kultivator.guide.c23.generasi.body:
Townsfolk time runs in Mortal Years: 2 world days a year. Babies grow into children, youths, adults, then elders; the average life is about 76 years, roughly 152 world days.
Townsfolk court, marry (always one man and one woman), have children, move towns, retire and die of age; children inherit half of their parents' impression of you.
The Family Tree in the Town Book shows whose child is whose and who is gone.
This step is done when a child you know grows up.
kultivator.guide.c23.nada.title: Silver Tongue
kultivator.guide.c23.nada.body:
Every choice you make in a conversation is an intent (ask, tell news, request, bargain, promise, refuse, praise, insult, leave) with a tone. Pick the tone on the small tablet at the right or with keys 1-6.
Polite is always safe. Friendly needs impression 20. Flirting only works on unmarried adults. Threatening uses the realm gap and Infamy, and in the capital with witnesses it is a crime. Bribing needs NB in your purse. Joking keeps the talk going, but not at a funeral.
The chance of success depends on the listener's temperament, feelings, impression and your standing; the number is not shown, only their face.
The same trick on the same person within a day grows weaker. Succeed with four different tones.
kultivator.guide.c23.nguping.title: Eavesdropping
kultivator.guide.c23.nguping.body:
Townsfolk chat among themselves: gossiping, arguing, flirting, trading, teaching, confiding and joking, and those talks change their relations and what they know.
Within 12 blocks you see their speech bubbles (at most 4 chats per place). Listen to the end: the news you overhear is noted in the News tab of the Town Book, such as tonight's Ghost Market spot or who owes the loan shark.
Click one of the speakers to cut in; both turn to you and your talk starts from their topic.
Overhear one piece of news.
kultivator.guide.c23.janji.title: Keep a Promise
kultivator.guide.c23.janji.body:
When you choose [I will ...] in a conversation, the townsperson notes the promise: what, for whom, and by which day. Each townsperson remembers up to 3 promises from you.
At your next meeting they open with a flashback when it falls due: "You promised last week to bring medicine for my mother...".
Keeping a promise changes their feelings, impression and the news that spreads about you; breaking it spreads too.
Keep one promise a townsperson remembered and called in.
kultivator.kota42.setelan.lentera.tip: Red, white, green and rabbit lanterns light up at night and sway in the wind.
kultivator.kota42.setelan.asap.tip: Chimney smoke from kitchens, eating houses and forges; thicker in winter.
kultivator.kota42.setelan.panji.tip: Banners that change with events: 囍 for a wedding, 奠 for mourning, New Year couplets, the protecting sect's emblem.
kultivator.kota42.setelan.petasan.tip: Firecrackers and red paper at weddings, plot openings and the New Year (client effect only).
kultivator.kota42.setelan.merpati.tip: Pigeon flocks circling over squares and rooftops.
kultivator.kota42.setelan.wayang.tip: Shadow-theatre silhouettes moving on candle-lit screens in the night district.
kultivator.kota42.setelan.jelaga.tip: Soot marks where a small fire was put out (client decal, no block changes).
kultivator.kota42.setelan.melodi.tip: Zithers, erhu, flutes and suona of street musicians, wedding players and travelling troupes.
